text: Street View coverage in Laos is very **limited**. Only five cities are covered: Vientiane, Vang Vieng, Luang Prabang, Savannakhet, and Pakse.
In addition, all coverage in Laos was taken by a Generation 3 camera.

All five cities have a distinct look and with some practise they are easily distinguishable from each other. The differences are discussed in more detail in the region-guessing section, but the summarized version is as follows:
- **Luang Prabang**: historical architecture, hills, palms
- **Vang Vieng**: distinct mountains
- **Vientiane**: no roof rack, large city
- **Savannakhet**: very flat
- **Pakse**: red soil, arid, hills
text_zh: 寮國的街景覆蓋非常**有限**。只有五個城市有覆蓋：永珍（Vientiane）、旺陽（Vang Vieng）、龍坡邦（Luang Prabang）、沙灣拿吉（Savannakhet）和巴色（Pakse）。
此外，寮國的所有覆蓋都是由第 3 相機世代拍攝的。
這五個城市都有獨特的外觀，經過一些練習後，它們很容易彼此區分。這些差異將在區域猜題部分進行更詳細的討論，但總結版本如下：
- **龍坡邦**：歷史建築、山丘、棕櫚樹
- **旺陽**：特異的山峰
- **永珍**：沒有車頂架、大城市
- **沙灣拿吉**：非常平坦
- **巴色**：紅土、乾旱、山丘

text: In all cities except for the capital, Vientiane, this Google car will be visible. It is silver-coloured, with a **roof rack** with two metal bars and black side mirrors.
NOTE: A similar car can be found in Guatemala, so be sure to look at the other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 除了首都永珍之外的所有城市，都可以看到這輛 Google 車。它是銀色的，配有一個帶有兩根金屬桿和黑色側視鏡的**車頂架**。
註記：瓜地馬拉也能找到類似的車輛，所以在猜測之前務必查看其他線索。

text: Laos drives on the **right hand** side of the road.
NOTE: This is mostly useful to distinguish between Thailand, which drives on the left hand side of the road.
text_zh: 寮國行駛在道路的**右側**。
註記：這主要有助於與行駛在道路左側的泰國進行區分。

text: Laotian licence plates are short and **yellow**. This distinguishes them from nearby Thailand and Cambodia, who both use white plates on non-commercial vehicles.
Laotian commercial plates are white, and government plates are blue.
NOTE: Thailand uses yellow plates for commercial vehicles, such as taxis.
text_zh: 寮國車牌很短且呈**黃色**。這使它們與鄰近的泰國和柬埔寨區分開來，這兩國的非營業車輛都使用白牌。
寮國的營業車牌是白色的，政府車牌則是藍色的。
註記：泰國的營業車輛（例如計程車）使用黃牌。

text: **Lao script** is compact and curvy, with some diacritics on top and below characters.
NOTE: It is very similar to Thai script, but (in most fonts) Lao script has fewer straight lines.
text_zh: **寮國文字**緊湊而曲線優美，字元上方和下方有一些附加符號。
註記：它與泰國文字非常相似，但（在大多數字型中）寮國文字的直線較少。

text: Laos is a majority **Buddhist** country. Buddhist temples are a common sight. They can be recognized by their ornate decorations, often with gold leaf detailing.
NOTE: Thailand and Cambodia are also majority Buddhist.
text_zh: 寮國是一個大多數人信仰**佛教**的國家。佛寺是很常見的景象。它們的特徵是華麗的裝飾，通常帶有金箔細節。
註記：泰國和柬埔寨也大多信仰佛教。

text: **Striped curbs** of various colours, such as red, yellow, or black with white, can be seen throughout Laos.
text_zh: 在整個寮國都可以看到各種顏色的**條紋緣石**，例如紅色、黃色，或是黑白相間。

text: **Stop signs** feature the Lao script. Sometimes, the sign features the word ‘stop’ in Latin script below the Lao script.
NOTE: In Laos, stop signs only have **2 characters,** compared to 3 in Thailand.
text_zh: **停止標誌**具有寮國文字。有時，標誌在寮國文字下方會標有拉丁字母的「stop」一詞。
註記：在寮國，停止標誌只有**2個字元，**相較之下泰國有3個。

text: Laos uses **square concrete poles**, with small pinholes on the sides in a row from top to bottom.
NOTE: Similar poles are found in Thailand, Sri Lanka, and less commonly, Cambodia.
text_zh: 寮國使用**方形混凝土電線桿**，側面從上到下有一排小針孔。
註記：泰國、斯里蘭卡以及較少見的柬埔寨也能找到類似的電線桿。

text: Laos uses square concrete **black and white bollards** with one or more black bands.
NOTE: Thailand, Indonesia, and rarely Cambodia use similar bollards.
text_zh: 寮國使用帶有一條或多條黑條的方形混凝土**黑白路樁**。
註記：泰國、印尼和少數情況下的柬埔寨會使用類似的路樁。

text: Some lamp posts have **diagonal red and white striped markings** that do not** **go down to the base.
text_zh: 有些燈桿有**斜向紅白條紋標記**，但這些標記**並沒有**延伸到基座。

text: A **red and white** painted cuboid concrete bollard can sometimes be seen a few metres off the side of the road.
text_zh: 有時可以在路邊幾公尺處看到塗有**紅白相間**的長方體混凝土路樁。

text: Laos has a communist government. You can sometimes see red **hammer and sickle flags**.
text_zh: 寮國是共產主義政府。你偶爾可以看到紅色的**錘子與鐮刀旗**。

text: Luang Prabang is located on the [Mekong River](https://goo.gl/maps/kdK5uhvp6kE4E3zc6) and surrounded by low **mountains** and hills (not always visible).
text_zh: 龍坡邦位於[湄公河](https://goo.gl/maps/kdK5uhvp6kE4E3zc6)畔，周圍環繞著低矮的**山脈**和丘陵（並不總是看得見）。

text: **Palm trees** are common in Luang Prabang.
text_zh: **棕櫚樹**在龍坡邦很常見。

text: Luang Prabang is the former royal capital of Laos and a UNESCO heritage site. The city has a lot of **historical architecture**, including several [temples](https://goo.gl/maps/T4rVQMmiqkaFBLhy7). Many buildings make use of traditional [dark wooden](https://goo.gl/maps/E5rWvMQBr5MH7Ar86) architectural elements. There are also some buildings dating back to [French colonial](https://goo.gl/maps/G9NRBCbmvH6QVwem8) rule of Laos.
text_zh: 龍坡邦是寮國的前皇家首都和聯合國教科文組織遺產。該市擁有許多**歷史建築**，包括幾座[寺廟](https://goo.gl/maps/T4rVQMmiqkaFBLhy7)。許多建築物利用了傳統的[深色木造](https://goo.gl/maps/E5rWvMQBr5MH7Ar86)建築元素。也有一些可以追溯到[法國殖民](https://goo.gl/maps/G9NRBCbmvH6QVwem8)寮國統治時期的建築。

text: Within Laos, **blue sign backs** are only found in Luang Prabang.
text_zh: 在寮國境內，**藍色標誌背面**僅見於龍坡邦。

text: This **rugged mountain range** can be seen from almost any point in Vang Vieng, and is the most reliable way of recognizing it.
NOTE: Vang Vieng has [very limited coverage](/images/laos/laos_vangviengcoverage.png); by far the least out of all 5 Lao cities. The actual coverage is also south of the Vang Vieng label on the map.
text_zh: 從旺陽的幾乎任何地方都可以看到這座**崎嶇的山脈**，這是識別它最可靠的方法。
註記：旺陽的[街景覆蓋非常有限](/images/laos/laos_vangviengcoverage.png)；是所有 5 個寮國城市中最少的。實際覆蓋範圍也在地圖上旺陽標籤的南方。

text: Vang Vieng is also very **touristic**: you will see a lot of signs for hotels, guesthouses, and other tourism-related enterprises. In the (very few) rounds that the distinct mountains are blocked by buildings, this is a good way to recognize the town.
text_zh: 旺陽也非常**觀光化**：你會看到大量關於飯店、民宿和其他旅遊相關企業的招牌。在特異山脈被建築物擋住的（極少數）回合中，這是識別該城鎮的好方法。

text: As previously mentioned, the Vientiane area is the only part of Laos where the Google car is **not **visible. It also has a considerable amount of rural coverage, especially to its southeast.
NOTE: This may lead to toss-ups with Thailand and Cambodia. Use the driving side (Thailand being left, and Laos and Cambodia right), along with other clues to tell them apart.
text_zh: 如前所述，永珍地區是寮國唯一**看不到** Google 車的地區。它也有相當多的鄉村街景覆蓋，特別是在其東南部。
註記：這可能會導致與泰國和柬埔寨難分難解。請使用行駛方向（泰國為左側，寮國和柬埔寨為右側）以及其他線索來區分牠們。

text: Road 450 east of Vientiane is made entirely of **concrete blocks**. It is also one of the very few divided highways in Laos with coverage.
text_zh: 永珍以東的 450 號公路完全由**混凝土塊**鋪成。它也是寮國極少數有街景覆蓋的分隔高速公路之一。

text: The divided highway that passes through Nong Beuak can be easily recognized by these **street lamps **that line the sides of the road.
NOTE: These streetlamps can also be found on the divided section of road 13, but it is more urban, and has a different road angle.
text_zh: 穿過農貝瓦（Nong Beuak）的分隔高速公路可以透過道路兩側排列的這些**路燈**輕譽識別。
註記：這些路燈也可以在 13 號公路的分隔路段上找到，但那裡更為都市化，且道路角度不同。

text: The road that goes through the conservation area features uniquely **hilly **terrain for Laos. Landscape around the road is also very **dry**, and mostly **forested**. Additionally, the road is in good condition with coloured curbs and dashed outer lines.
NOTE: It is the only single lane road that has black and white or yellow and white curbs.
text_zh: 穿過保育區的道路具有寮國少見的**丘陵**地形。道路周圍的景觀也非常**乾旱**，且大多為**森林**。此外，道路狀況良好，配有彩色緣石和虛線外側標線。
註記：這是唯一一條擁有黑白或黃白緣石的單車道道路。

text: The only trekker in Laos is a view of the monumental **Patuxai** arch, a massive war memorial in the middle of Vientiane. Some of the coverage is made with a normal trekker, and some with a [tripod](https://goo.gl/maps/Jhfo521otTgghE1W9).
text_zh: 寮國唯一的徒步拍攝街景是宏偉的**凱旋門**（Patuxai），這是一座位於永珍市中心的大型戰爭紀念碑。部分覆蓋是用普通徒步拍攝製作的，部分則是用[三腳架](https://goo.gl/maps/Jhfo521otTgghE1W9)拍攝的。

text: Savannakhet is very **flat**: the only mountains that are visible are on the other side of the Mekong river, in Thailand.
It is also recognizable as its soil has a **slight red** tinge, however not as red as Pakse.
NOTE: On Google Maps, the label for Savannakhet is hidden under the label of the Thai province of Mukdahan until you zoom in relatively close. You can find Savannakhet by going west of Xeno.
text_zh: 沙灣拿吉非常**平坦**：唯一能見到的山脈在湄公河對岸的泰國境內。
它也可以透過其土壤帶有**微紅**色調來辨識，不過沒有巴色那麼紅。
註記：在 Google 地圖上，沙灣拿吉的標籤藏在泰國莫拉限府（Mukdahan）的標籤下方，直到你放大到相對接近的程度。你可以透過向西前往瑟農（Xeno）來找到沙灣拿吉。

text: The southern city of Pakse is easily recognizable thanks to the distinct **red **soil.
The vegetation is also uniquely **dry**, with equally [dry hills](https://goo.gl/maps/VRfYqJdVfgmuNvwL6) nearby.
text_zh: 南部的巴色由於鮮明的**紅色**土壤而很容易辨識。
植被也異常**乾旱**，附近有同樣[乾旱的山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/VRfYqJdVfgmuNvwL6)。

text: This 1380-metre long **bridge **crosses the Mekong River next to the city of Pakse. It is the only major bridge in Laos with coverage.
text_zh: 這座長達 1380 公尺的**橋樑**在巴色市旁跨越湄公河。這是寮國唯一有街景覆蓋的主要橋樑。
